extract: Katie Elizabeth Boyd Britt is an American politician and attorney serving as the junior United States senator from Alabama since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, she was previously president and CEO of the Business Council of Alabama from 2019 to 2021, and served as chief of staff for Senator Richard Shelby from 2016 to 2018.
